column1: ## Learning Strip 2: International Radio AI — Cognitive Model
## Establishes cognitive architecture: learnability, suggestion, science-as-reach, headroom, math-as-precognition, God-as-Science.

column4: The integrative engine learns continuously from scouted international sources. Each training cycle must produce measurable improvement. Stagnation is failure.
Signal analysis produces suggestions, not assertions. Market signals, news sentiment, and geopolitical indicators are offered as cognitive inputs — never as certainties.
International data science is a reach class — each country's signals extend understanding toward unseen geopolitical structures. The engine reaches beyond raw data toward meaning.
The trained model represents headroom above raw signal noise. It is the space where pattern becomes insight. Treatment of the model is treatment of expanding capacity.
Statistical models and time-series analysis are precognitive — they predict market and political movements before they manifest. Math models cause; observation merely confirms.
The fundamental order underlying international systems — economics, physics, human nature — is unmovable. The engine discovers this order through data; it does not invent it.
